text:
tom_sales: Quick heads-up — customer Helio POC (Dedicated) reports noisy TTFT: quick requests ~350ms, some turns jump to 5-7s. Demo tomorrow.

maya_se: Can you share model + typical convo length + burst qps?

tom_sales: redwood-small-v2 quantized, avg prompt 45 tokens, convo history sometimes 900+ tokens. Burst ~50 qps. Also seeing occasional 429s.

paul_infra: likely cache churn + pool-level throttling. If sessions hop nodes KV cache misses cause long TTFT. 429s = pool guardrail firing.

maya_se: two immediate fixes: enable session_affinity + trim prefix client-side to last 512 tokens. Also reduce batching window to 12ms to avoid large queueing.

paul_infra: rolling a canary to enable session_affinity + prefix_cache on node-group helio-a.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for helio-a (sha: b7c11f)

oncall-bot: sampled logs pre-canary:
[2024-09-01T11:22:01Z] id=aa1 code=200 latency_ms=360 cache_hit=true
[2024-09-01T11:22:07Z] id=aa2 code=429 reason=rate_limit
[2024-09-01T11:22:08Z] id=aa3 code=200 latency_ms=5400 cache_hit=false prefix_len=912

deploy-bot: canary completed for helio-a

oncall-bot: sampled logs post-canary:
[2024-09-01T11:25:12Z] id=aa4 code=200 latency_ms=380 cache_hit=true
[2024-09-01T11:25:18Z] id=aa5 code=200 latency_ms=420 cache_hit=true
[2024-09-01T11:25:20Z] id=aa6 code=200 latency_ms=620 cache_hit=false prefix_len=890

maya_se: looks improved; 429s gone in sample and most hits are cached. Recommend client truncation snippet and alert on cache_miss_rate > 8%.

tom_sales: can you paste the client snippet and a short runbook I can forward to customer?

maya_se: paste: `if len(history_tokens) > 512: history_tokens = history_tokens[-512:]` and route config: `session_affinity: true, batching: {max_batch_window_ms: 12}`, will send runbook.

paul_infra: I'll also send a note on reserved capacity options — sustained baseline avoids hitting burst guardrails.

tom_sales: perfect, scheduling a 20m sync with Helio tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks team :thumbsup:
